_comment: Active data-only route. Gate L is archived as unexecuted because the required independent TE-locus experts are unavailable.
goal: Determine whether prediction-defined internal gaps from frozen P3-R1 contain enough non-geometric information for high-precision Human comparator-consistent repeat-mask refinement.
objective: Run the sequential E0 engineering preflight and feature-only GAP-BRIDGE-DATA-GATE-V0 defined in docs/experiments/GAP-BRIDGE-DATA-ONLY-RESTART-20260901.md. Do not train a new neural sequence encoder or continue P3 unless the feature-only gate passes.

candidate_contract.model: deterministic baselines plus one L2-regularized logistic regression probe

authorized_work: run the chr17 frozen-logit export identity regression without reading a new scientific metric
materialize the 100-Mb chr3/chr5 engineering preflight and then the frozen full-chromosome Human Phase-0 split
export frozen P3-R1 four-state logits and canonical binary predictions
generate callable prediction-defined internal gap candidates of 1-512 bp before comparator projection
project COMPARATOR_BRIDGE_SUPPORTED, COMPARATOR_SEPARATION_SUPPORTED and COMPARATOR_RELATION_AMBIGUOUS labels
run distance, frozen-logit, raw-sequence summary, deterministic alignment baselines and one L2 logistic probe
run the prospective added-bp and gene-feature safety evaluation
closed_work: manual Gate L annotation under the current resource constraint
biological insertion or nested-topology claims from the Human comparator
new Transformer, CNN or backbone update before Phase-0 PASS
continual or hard-example learning before library-free signal survives chr19, the homology-purged challenge, chr20-22 confirmation and unchanged Mouse transfer
generic or TE-aware masking-only MLM rescue
threshold, minimum-length, HMM, CRF or renamed smoothing rescue
Mouse or Fly development before the Human gate

claim_policy.publication_use: route-selection and comparator-refinement mechanism evidence only
claim_policy.positive_scope: Human comparator-consistent internal-gap fill on frozen regions
claim_policy.prohibited_scope: biological insertion identity, nested topology, ancestral boundary, de novo discovery with a library, or gene-prediction improvement without rerunning a predictor

stop_rules.E0: If new-region materialization, coordinate stitching or frozen-logit export fails, fix only the minimal engineering defect; do not infer a scientific result.
stop_rules.PHASE0: If the combined feature model fails the frozen information, added-bp, whole-mask or gene-feature gate, close the neural gap-classifier and continual-learning route.
stop_rules.A0: If deterministic alignment evidence matches the combined model, select the deterministic method and stop neural development.
stop_rules.CONTINUAL: A new continual-learning proposal is eligible only after library-free raw-sequence gain persists on chr19 and the homology-purged challenge, reproduces on chr20-22, and is directionally consistent under unchanged Mouse transfer.
